name: The God Eaters
description:
Irebbi Yeččan, Pemakan Dewa, Guðaæturnar, Burkhan Zalgigchid, I Divoratori: Each corner of the world has a name that carries a weight of great fear, of dread, of foreboding.

Their coming has been marked as long as time has moved in its course, and it is always the same: the edges of the world are torn open, great black forms writhe across the skies, dousing the sun. Then the thousand mouths: seeking, finding, devouring, stripping the world of those who shine brightest. Sated, they slink back from whence they came, and brood there until their hunger rises once more.

We do not know what they are. There is nothing we can do to stop them.

⁂ ⁂ ⁂

The God Eaters are an extra-planar force that appears at regular intervals and literally eats the gods of the world, destroying them utterly and absorbing their power. How often they come is up to you. How many they take depends on how hungry they are.

If you choose to use this world module, discuss as a group and set a specific interval for the coming of the God Eaters: millennia, centuries, decades, years, etc., or triggered by a specific event. It's up to you. They can be something nearly forgotten and barely preserved in legend, a well-known natural force like the weather, or somewhere in between.

Describe how the coming of the God Eaters has shaped the Cultures of your world.

THE ARRIVAL & THE DEVOURING

When the God Eaters arrive, roll a fate die:

  • On 🌞, they fail to devour any gods, but the roll for their next coming will be favored.

  • On 💀, they will attempt to devour all gods.

  • On 1-10, the result becomes the Difficulty and is also the number of gods they will attempt to devour. For each ✨, reduce the Difficulty by 1.

When the God Eaters attempt to devour, they start with the most powerful god, then move on to the next-most powerful, and so on:

  • If you are using the Godhood world module, use each god's Devotion score.

  • If you are not using Godhood, simply discuss as a group and rank the gods of the world according to their current levels of power and influence.

Either way, when the God Eaters attempt to devour a particular god, the god and its followers may attempt to resist. Make a skill check against the Difficulty on their behalf (the GM should make this roll during the Quest Phase, or any player during Intermezzo). The number of ranks for the check is determined by the god's power:

  • If you are using Godhood, the number of ranks for the check is equal to the god's current Devotion score, divided by 100 - rounded down, no maximum.

  • If not using Godhood, subtract the god's position on the ranked list of gods from 10. The result is the number of ranks for the check.

Once you've determined the number of ranks, roll against the Difficulty, adding 1 to the result for each ✨:

  • On a pass or 🌞, the god is not devoured.

  • On failure or 💀, the god is devoured. Reduce the Difficulty by 1.

When a god is devoured, its power is completely consumed. Any effects or works they were sustaining with their power immediately fail, any creatures benefitting from their influence immediately lose those benefits, and the god's domain becomes untended.

When the Difficulty is reduced to 0, or when they have eaten all the gods in this world, the God Eaters depart.

Describe how the God Eaters appear in this world, how they hunt down and devour the gods, and how the world changes as power leaves it.
